name: sciglyph-math-physics-symbols
title: SciGlyph: Math & Physics Symbols
description: Fast Raycast picker for math, physics, chemistry, and scientific notation symbols. Search by symbol, name, or meaning, then paste directly into any app.
author: zohaib_arsalan

commands.name: search-symbols
commands.title: Search Symbols
commands.subtitle: SciGlyph
commands.description: Search and paste math, physics, chemistry, and scientific notation symbols.

scripts.prepublishOnly:

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
